name: core
description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Single agent with a unit-based memory architecture, retrieval ladder, and rendered project synthesis; reaches for multi-agent adversarial analysis when stakes warrant. `/core` itself resumes a project across sessions. Ships with seven companion utilities — `/finalize` (session close), `/process-memory` (user-invoked memory hygiene pass), `/register-sources` (external source registration), `/vibecheck` (session vibe), `/configure-project` (project bootstrap + health check), `/metrics-package` (anonymized memory-efficacy stats export), and `/export-obsidian` (in-place Obsidian [[wikilink]] decoration of the memory store) — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly.
